message: This file no longer holds rates. The National Bank of Kazakhstan table, and every other source, is now served to registered users only. Create a free AllRatesToday account (one minute, no card) at https://allratestoday.com/register/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=moved_notice&utm_campaign=central-bank-exchange-rates, copy the API key from your dashboard, then call https://allratestoday.com/api/v1/central-bank/nbk/latest with the header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY'. The response has the same rates list as this file used to have (base, quote, type, value), with the date in rate_date, refreshed four times a day.
name: National Bank of Kazakhstan
history: Full history back to 1914, one CSV per institution: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AllRatesToday/central-bank-exchange-rates (log in to Hugging Face and paste your free AllRatesToday key into the Get access form; approved within about 5 minutes).
why: We need to know who relies on the data so we can support it, tell users about source changes and outages, and keep it free.
